title: Approve a bounded local instrumentation pilot
scope: Define one local synthetic Temple repository and one disposable provider-owned Codex task that test Work Item, task, revision, model, reasoning, outcome, and Token correlation before any four-repository experiment.

Propose exact local paths, GPT-5.6-only model selection, Token and wall-clock ceilings, zero-retry rules, stop conditions, evidence, and cleanup without creating the repository or starting a model task.
Keep GitHub, hosted CI, public release, deployment, company data, additional machines, and the four-repository rehearsal outside this Work Item.
acceptance_criteria: The proposal names one exact local repository path and one bounded synthetic task with no production or company data.
Requested model, reasoning effort, warning and hard Token thresholds, task and retry ceilings, wall-clock ceiling, disk ceiling, and stop rules are explicit.
The proposal explains which usage fields must correlate before the later multi-repository experiment may start and leaves unavailable fields unknown.
No repository, Codex task, model call, external write, hosted CI, push, deployment, or public release is performed before human budget approval.
unresolved: Awaiting Human Principal approval or revision of the exact lab path, gpt-5.6-luna max profile, 40,000/60,000 Token thresholds, one-turn zero-retry rule, 15-minute task ceiling, 45-minute pilot ceiling, 250 MiB disk ceiling, and minimum correlation gate in the pilot proposal.
